title: G's Dash
description: Driver display and car hub in nine looks (Simple, M Style, GT, Heritage, Flight, Digital '84, Sim Racing, Lumen, Pixel). Swipe between Showcase (the car, Spotify or a clock), Drive (opens first; shift lights, gear, rpm, speed, g-meter, drive mode badge, oil / coolant in °F or the fuel level), Warm-up (warm-up rev limit), G-force (peak hold) and Tires (TPMS). Optional Spotify panel (art, previous / play-pause / next, seek; own QR sign-in, Spotify Premium and mgu-uplink internet). Optional Cluster map setting: CarPlay's map on the instrument cluster through the separately installed Waze on cluster tool (off unless installed and turned on). While open, the G's Dash logo in the cluster's centre map area when no map uses it, through the separately installed Cluster renderer tool (setting, on by default; nothing happens without the tool)

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.FE._optional: the drive mode badge: statusFESVehicleDynamicSwitchHMI.actualValueModeDrivingExperience (enum ActualValueModeDrivingExperience2, by name or number); its pop-up request flags mark a change

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.TPMS._optional: the Tires screen: pressures, temperatures, targets, status (UInt16 raw: pressure x0.1 in the car's unit, temperature raw-40; read every 10 s; raw values logged and on the diagnostics page)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: the car's display units (air pressure, temperature) for the TPMS values

de.bmw.infotainment.lsc.LSCDataSink._optional: the fuel bar's level: fuelSupply.relativeFuelLevelEstimate (UInt16, read as %; as 0.1 % once a value above 100 arrives; raw values logged)

de.bmw.infotainment.KombiIF._optional: the fuel bar's range and reserve: statusRangeTankStatus.range (km), .statusFluidLevelFuelTankSpare (AKTIV = reserve), .fluidLevelFuelTank (litres, only without a %); no other member is read

de.bmw.powertrain.Range._optional: the fuel bar's range and low-fuel warning: dataRangeDisplay.dataRangeDisplayTotal in .unitRangeDisplay, .rangeWarningFuelLevel (GERING = low)

startWidget.comment: Home-screen widget: just the G logo, large and centred (widget_logo.js from tools/make_g_icon.py: the mark alone, transparent, at 'size' and inside 'safe'). Same layout and cells as upstream's apps/edrive widget (BMW's Drive Recorder widget on this firmware): the picture goes into BackgroundImage1; every text line and the progress bar are written empty here once per placed widget. The small widget shows no pictures on this firmware (upstream's finding), so main.js sets its Title to the app's name; the big one's Title stays empty. 'safe' = share of width / height kept clear on each side (the HMI crops the edges).
startWidget.name: G's Dash
